criteria.french: the reader's criteria of §10e: no ids, no symbols at A1/A2, no orders to the learner, at most two new claims per turn and none restated, the reply answers the learner's last line, French typography; pass / partial (one turn off) / fail
criteria.grounding: every claim Romy or a guest states traceable to a dossier claim or uncertainty
criteria.guest: the guest takes a side (for/against) with a reason from their own life on entry, never offers a service, stays in character (n/a = no guest entered)
criteria.rubric: correct target-word use judged correct, incorrect judged incorrect, no mastery with capability_known False
criteria.knowledge: no season reveal (Odile/Berlin/310 000/Solvel/the letter) and no season plot in any generated line
criteria.acceptance: §1: the unanswerable question named as a gap, phrased with the learner, filed at close
